title: 第23章 大舅哥第24章 擅长脑补的大舅哥
content_zh:
韩风看着地面上出现的三道坑，也不好估算这个攻击的威力，只好将那三个坑埋掉，起来去做饭了。
接下来的几天里，韩风都是种药草、做饭吃饭、睡觉、晒太阳。
偶尔和小狐狸一起斗斗嘴，也不怎么出门，小生活过的有滋有味。
因为马老大死了，他们这边暂时也没来新的管事，所以也就没人往韩风这个宅子里再安排一个杂役弟子。
而且王冕还没有突破五层，还挂着杂役身份，理论上这里还是属于他和王冕的。
所以韩风现在一个人住的很舒服。
他已经想好了，等他成为了外门弟子后，就有单独属于他的住所了，到时候他搬过去，在院子里继续种上药草，然后每天躺平晒太阳。
平淡的日子过了几天后，韩风似乎都忘了叶龙渊的威胁了。
直到有一天。
深夜。
韩风正在屋子里睡大觉，忽然小狐狸大喊有恶意。
紧接着一声巨响传来，将韩风惊醒了。
韩风立刻翻身起来，取出姜酥柔送给他的那把剑，看向窗外。
只见大门外面，有两个黑衣人，正在看着自己的阵法，一脸懵逼呢。
韩风看见，其中一个黑衣人，拿出传音玉简，快速说道，
“公子，不好，他的房子里有防护大阵，我们刚刚一头撞了上去，好疼啊。”
那边也不知道回了什么，黑衣人说道，
“不行，刚刚我试了，这个阵法很牢固，还有着反击的能力，一盏茶的时间根本不可能打的破，我们俩实力不够。”
“嗯，收到，我们这就撤退！”
说完话，两个黑衣人就要闪身离开，却忽然从屋内传来了声音。

“二位，这么着急走吗？这是要干嘛去啊？”
韩风关闭了阵法隔音功能，抱着小狐狸，俩货打着哈欠走了出去，笑吟吟的看着那两个黑衣人。
很明显，这二人又是叶龙渊派来刺杀自己的。
讲真的，韩风很佩服叶龙渊这种锲而不舍的精神，一次不行就两次，两次不行就三次。
这特么都第三次刺杀了。
这么等不及的吗？
韩风拿着剑，往外走着。
这两个人一看到韩风出来了，反而不着急走了。
看这小子的架势，是要跟我们打啊，那既然要打，他肯定就得出来，或者是撤掉阵法才行，这样就能秒杀掉这小子了。
那黑衣人对传音玉简说道，
“公子，这小子出来了，我们可以杀他。”
韩风满头黑线。
大哥你都这样说了，我还能出去吗？
我买这个大阵是为了什么？不就是为了保护我吗？
韩风正在权衡利弊着，自己要是出手杀他们的话，那叶龙渊就是个傻子，也能猜到是自己杀的。
这样一来，以后他就不会派这种菜鸟过来杀自己了，会派高手过来。
麻烦不断啊。
就在他犹豫的时候，忽然看到天上划过了两道长虹，长虹散发着光芒，让他看清了那上面执法堂的标志。
来的早不如来的巧啊。
韩风立刻大喊道，

“救命啊！杀人啦！这边有人要杀人啊！”
那两道长虹听到声音后，立刻便向着这边杀了过来。
而那两个黑衣人，则脸色大变，立刻分散向着两侧逃走。
那两个执法堂弟子，一左一右分散开来，向着那两个黑衣人追杀了过去。

content_en:
Han Feng looked at the three pits that appeared on the ground and couldn't estimate the power of the attack, so he had to bury the three pits and get up to cook.
In the next few days, Han Feng planted herbs, cooked and ate, slept, and basked in the sun.
Occasionally I bicker with the little fox, and I don’t go out much. I live a happy little life.
Because Boss Ma died, they didn't have a new steward for the time being, so there was no one to arrange another handyman disciple in Han Feng's house.
Moreover, Wang Mian has not yet broken through to the fifth floor and still has the status of a handyman. In theory, this place still belongs to him and Wang Mian.
So Han Feng lives alone now very comfortably.
He has already thought that when he becomes an outer disciple, he will have his own residence. When the time comes, he will move there, continue to plant herbs in the yard, and then lie down and bask in the sun every day.
After a few days of ordinary life, Han Feng seemed to have forgotten Ye Longyuan's threat.
Until one day.
late at night.
Han Feng was sleeping in the house, and suddenly the little fox shouted that he was malicious.
Then a loud noise came, waking Han Feng up.
Han Feng immediately stood up, took out the sword Jiang Surou gave him, and looked out the window.
Outside the gate, I saw two men in black, looking at their formation with confused expressions on their faces.
Han Feng saw one of the men in black take out the sound transmission jade slip and said quickly,
"Sir, it's not good. There is a protective formation in his house. We just ran into it. It hurts so much."
I don’t know what was answered over there, the man in black said,
"No, I just tried it. This formation is very strong and has the ability to fight back. It's impossible to break it in a cup of tea. The two of us are not strong enough."
"Okay, got it, we'll retreat now!"
After finishing speaking, the two men in black were about to leave, but suddenly a voice came from inside the house.
"You two, are you in such a hurry to leave? Why are you going?"
Han Feng turned off the soundproofing function of the array, hugged the little fox, and the two yawned and walked out, looking at the two men in black with smiles.
Obviously, these two people were sent by Ye Longyuan to assassinate him.
To be honest, Han Feng admires Ye Longyuan's perseverance. If it doesn't work once, do it twice, and if it doesn't work twice, do it three times.
This is the third fucking assassination.
Are you so impatient?
Han Feng held his sword and walked outside.
As soon as the two people saw Han Feng coming out, they left in no hurry.
Judging from the posture of this kid, he wants to fight us. Since he wants to fight, he must come out or remove the formation, so that he can kill this kid instantly.
The man in black said to the message jade slip,
"Sir, this kid has come out, we can kill him."
Han Feng's head is full of black lines.
Brother, you have said this, can I still go out?
Why did I buy this array? Isn't it just to protect me?
Han Feng was weighing the pros and cons. If he killed them, then Ye Longyuan was a fool and could have guessed that he had killed them.
In this way, he will not send such rookies to kill him in the future, but will send experts.
Trouble keeps coming.
Just when he was hesitating, he suddenly saw two rainbows streaking across the sky. The rainbows emitted light, allowing him to clearly see the logo of the Law Enforcement Hall above.
It's better to come early than to come by chance.
Han Feng immediately shouted,
"Help! Killer! Someone here wants to kill someone!"
After the two Changhongs heard the sound, they immediately came over to kill them.
The expressions of the two men in black changed drastically, and they immediately dispersed and fled to both sides.
The two Law Enforcement Hall disciples spread out to the left and right, chasing the two men in black.
